findings.message: The CRD workspaces.app.terraform.io under crds/ changed (the file contents changed). Plain Helm does not upgrade CRDs in that directory. helm upgrade leaves the CRD already in the cluster as it is, and CRDs are not installed on upgrade or rollback.
Role/default/stageproof-rel-terraform-sync-workspace adds rules that the current chart did not have.
Chart default `global.imageK8S` changed from `hashicorp/terraform-k8s:1.1.0` to `hashicorp/terraform-k8s:1.1.2` and the rendered objects differ.

The pod template of Deployment/stageproof-check/stageproof-rel-terraform-sync-workspace changed at spec.template.spec.containers[name=terraform-sync-workspace].image. The pods will restart. A restart is normal for an upgrade.

findings.detail: The render names a different image, including images on custom resources and images passed as container arguments. Whether that tag exists is a separate check.
findings.message: 1 container image changed. Deployment/stageproof-check/stageproof-rel-terraform-sync-workspace.template.spec.containers[0] terraform-sync-workspace container moves from hashicorp/terraform-k8s:1.1.0 to hashicorp/terraform-k8s:1.1.2.

findings.detail: A rehearsal installs the chart into an empty cluster. It does not upgrade data that is already there. An empty-cluster result of 0 restarts does not mean an existing workload stayed up.
findings.message: This chart ships custom resource definitions, and the application it runs is changing. Custom resources that already exist on a real cluster are not in this check.
